reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed V4 (agent's favourite): linear ST steady-state gain v*delta_lag/(L*(1+K_us*v^2)) with L=2.984, K_us=5.0e-4, first-order steering lag tau=0.08 s, plus per-segment residual-mean bias removal; parameters read from out/ladder.json.
notes: Agent only fit/scored on FORD_MUSTANG_MACH_E_MK1 (315 segs); we apply the same L=2.984 (Mach-E wheelbase) and Mach-E-fit K_us=5.0e-4 across all 545 canonical Ford segments including F-150 Lightning, per leakage_note. Of 545 segments globbed, 521 contributed samples (24 had no rows after v>2 filter); pooled sample count matches canonical exactly. Per-segment bias removal uses each segment's residual mean (legitimate sensor-zero correction per the agent's pipeline). Baseline recomputation matches canonical V0 to floating precision; agent's Mach-E-only fit generalises poorly to F-150 Lightning (different wheelbase, mass, tyres), hence the negative pooled improvement.
